subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
6. 
While auditing Happy Pvt. Ltd., CA M reviews a large number of invoices 
collected by the audit team. However, noticing that only a few have 
third-party confirmations, CA M reminds the team that simply having 
more documents doesn't ensure strong audit evidence and explained 
that reliability or quality matters too. What CA M is trying to explain in 
the given situation? 
(a)  
Sufficiency relates to quality; appropriateness relates to quantity. 
(b)  
Internal documents are always sufficient and appropriate. 
(c)  
More documents mean better audit evidence. 
(d)  
Sufficiency refers to quantity; appropriateness refers to quality.
